messages:
lina (design): quick thing from today's usability session — users confused when rules list is empty after filters. they expected guidance and felt the preview area was unrelated. henry (pm): got it. we should show contextual affordances: what filters are active, why nothing matches, and next steps (create rule / clear filter / view docs). kai (frontend): technical note: empty-state currently replaces the list which causes scrollbar disappearance and layout shift. i can reserve vertical space and render a slim placeholder card instead to keep height stable. also avoid heavy svg assets to keep bundle small. jules (a11y): accessibility notes: - announce active filters + total count in a single polite live region: "0 rules match. filters applied: environment=prod, tag=fraud" - reorder hint: show visual hint but expose text via sr-only: "Drag handle, press space to lift, arrow keys to reorder" - for the preview overlay, use role=dialog with aria-modal=false (since preview isn't a modal) and ensure escape collapses it from keyboard POV lina (design): suggestion for microcopy: headline then one-line hint. e.g., "No rules found for these filters." "Try clearing filters or create a new rule to simulate traffic." henry (pm): also uncovered a small UX regression: when a rule is dragged to reorder and the network call fails we show an inline toast that disappears after 3s. users missed the undo. propose: persistent inline error with 'Retry' and 'Undo' actions and visible red outline on the affected rule. kai (frontend): agreed. implementation plan: optimistic reorder locally, call API, if error then revert visually and show an error banner attached to the list with two buttons. sample aria pattern:
\n Reordering failed. \n
also, will add data-test attrs for storybook cases. jules (a11y): small nit: ensure the error banner receives focus when it appears so screen readers announce it; don't move focus away from current task unless user action is required. include aria-describedby on the rule being highlighted to link to the error text. lina (design): preview panel: users assumed dimming = broken. alternative: show a compact centered card titled "No snapshot selected" + action buttons: 'Select snapshot' and tiny 'Create one' link. keep visual hierarchy subtle and retain background traces of the simulation so users know where preview will appear. henry (pm): decision list: - improve empty-state copy + show active filters context (owner: lina) - reserve min-height for rules list to prevent jump (owner: kai) - optimistic reorder with persistent error banner + Undo/Retry (owner: kai) - aria patterns: polite live region for counts, assertive alert for reorder failures; focus the alert when shown (owner: jules) - preview overlay card instead of dim-only (owner: lina + kai) kai (frontend): i'll open a PR with storybook stories: empty state, overlay, reorder-fail. will include automated test that simulates fetch fail. ETA: Wednesday EOD. ci-bot: build queued for branch feature/routing-emptystates — status: pending. jules (a11y): i'll draft a 1-page checklist for the PR: live-region content, focus management, keyboard reordering instructions, contrast for the hint text (target AA). lina (design): i'll add mockups to the design doc and include copy variants for localization checks. tiny UX detail: make the reorder helper visible on hover/focus only; SR-only text should always be present. henry (pm): thanks everyone. i'll put these into the sprint ticket and link PR when ready. we'll validate in next usability follow-up. :rocket:
